title: Bump opum-quest federated pin to v0.10.0

finalSummary: Dispatched by opum-agent (OPAG-378), alongside OMARK-66's lore 0.9.2 pin, following opum-cli-e2e's TASK-106 joint qualification of quest 0.10.0 + lore 0.9.2. Spans 100 commits / 172 changed files (v0.7.1...v0.10.0 compare API) but zero content change under skills/: independently confirmed the skills subtree SHA is byte-identical to the v0.7.1 baseline via direct tree resolution (root tree -> skills entry, both sides), not merely an empty compare-API diff -- a git tree SHA hashes its content, so this is proof. All three required checks green on PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#152's head SHA 34aa9a45.
